Local frequency partition separates the finite positive Laguerre circles while preserving Lp. Every localized term is an entire Helmholtz solution; angular Bessel coefficients cannot lie in planar Lp for p<=4 unless zero. Angularly averaged null characters yield the J0 counterexample for p>4, and its fourth-power annular asymptotic produces 3/(4πλ) log R+O(1). The all-degree and all-exponent proof is analytical, not finite enumeration.
